input.summary: Add mutual uncapped carve-out (Excluded Claims) for confidentiality/data protection, indemnities, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short mutual carve-out so that confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, indemnities, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP sit outside the Section 9 limits and the data/records exclusion; our playbook requires these Excluded Claims to be uncapped. The mutual caps and the Section 10 consequential-damages exclusion are otherwise acceptable to us.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. Notwithstanding Sections 9.1 and 9.2 (including Subsection 9.1(c)(2)), the limitations and exclusions of liability in this Section 9 do not apply to Excluded Claims, and each party remains fully liable for its Excluded Claims. "Excluded Claims" means a party's indemnification obligations under Section 8, a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, a party's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
